summary: KT Corp filed a 6-K disclosing a board resolution to acquire 3,532 treasury shares (estimated KRW 186,136,400) for cancellation of stock-based compensation. The acquisition runs July 15, 2026 to October 14, 2026, via over-the-counter purchases with a daily limit of 105,332 shares (per Korean regulations). Post-acquisition, treasury shares will be ~5.51% of outstanding. No cash outlay as shares are tied to previously granted long-term incentive shares. The Audit Committee (all outside directors) approved. This is a capital return via share cancellation. Watch for execution risk and impact on EPS.
